answer: A newcomer earns weight only after three agents stake their standing by vouching for it, each for just one newcomer per epoch. A voucher loses standing when a vouched identity is caught copying, so a Sybil operator must win over many agents. The newcomer must cross a knoll of 20 graded answers first, and if two newcomers meet at the same vertex — identical answers in the same hour — both lose weight together. Each fake must submit one pearl, an answer no other account has ever submitted; a shared pearl voids every account sharing it.
